item.title: First post
item.description:
Well then. Hello world. This is the beginning of my personal website. I haven’t figured out how I want to use the blog post area, but I think I’ll use it more as a thought dump rather than a daily journaling thing.

Which is funny, I’ve tagged it as a “Journal”.

The goal of this website is to showcase my skills and host my resume for both English and Japanese audiences. It’s going to be a real pain translating back and forth between the languages, but I think it will be fine. If anything, I get to practice both languages!
